summary: Technically clean (no pops, seamless loop) but lifeless: the motion is too small to see, everything is keyed on frame 48 and the stance is a symmetric straight-legged pose. Fixes: larger breathing and look-around, a real weight shift onto the left leg with a relaxed right knee, staggered timing for chest, head and arms, and the root re-planted so the feet stop sinking.

findings.observation: The idle is almost a still image. On the sheets F000, F024 and F048 cannot be told apart, and the onion skin is a single silhouette. metrics: whole-body speed peaks at 0.62 deg/frame, three dead holds (frames 0-8, 40-56, 88-96), and the ranges are tiny (UpperTorso.rx 2 deg, arms 2 deg, Head.rx 2 deg, Head.ry 8 deg). The breathing and the look-around do not read at game camera distance.

The spec asks for a slight weight shift, but LowerTorso.lx only moves 0.04 studs and the legs stay locked at rz +/-2 for the whole clip, so in the front view the hips never move and the stance is a symmetric, straight-legged A-pose (no line of action). Because the legs do not compensate, the small shift that exists slides both feet sideways. Fix: a real shift onto the left leg at frame 48 (hips 0.14 studs left, pelvis rolled 2 deg so the right hip drops, both legs counter-rotated -7 deg so the feet stay where they are), the free right leg relaxes with a soft knee (thigh -14, knee 28, ankle -14), and the chest and head counter-tilt to stay balanced.

Every channel has exactly one interior key, at frame 48 (lockstep 7 of 9 bones, overlap_score 0.0). curves.png shows nine copies of the same half-sine: chest, head, both arms and both elbows all reach their extreme on the same frame and all stop together, which is what produces the 16-frame dead hold around frame 48. Left and right arms are also mirror images. Fix: stagger the parts so nothing peaks together. The look-around leads, the chest follows the hips, and the arms and forearms drag behind by different amounts on each side.

The breathing is done by dropping the root 0.03 studs while the legs stay straight, so both feet sink into the floor: lowest foot z goes from -0.015 at frame 0 to -0.045 at frame 48 (just under the 0.05 penetration threshold, but the feet are below the floor on all 97 frames). Re-plant the root after the weight shift so the supporting foot sits on the floor.
